race.comment: THEBLADE (13) dominated on resumption off the one trial when sitting on the speed for a slick victory over 1200m at Rosehill. Jumps slightly in grade and can go on with it this campaign. BESKAR (4) South Pacific winner who will find this more to his liking after being outclassed on resumption when eighth in the G2 Concorde Stakes over 1000m at this track. Maps well and has genuine top three prospects. AMAZING EAGLE (20) hard fit for this and gets every chance on the limit. SURF'S UP (18) resumes after making good progress over the winter months. Fitted with the one trial and gets map favours. Can feature.
